title: 第3章 技能附魔第4章 谎言
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
;;
想到词条，维克多心中一动。
昨晚情况太过危急，他甚至没来得及仔细查看自己的金手指面板。
随着意念微动，那个熟悉的半透明界面再次浮现在视网膜上。
【姓名：维克多】
【状态：轻微虚弱（恢复中）】
【基础属性】
力量：5.3
敏捷：4.5
体质：5.5
精神：7.7（抵抗了一次精神污染，你的意志更加坚韧了）
由于上次查看面板时的情形过于危急，导致维克多甚至没有发现，在基础数值的下方还有他已经习得的技能。
【技能栏】这具身体虽然没有经过系统训练，但五年的耳濡目染，让你掌握了一些基础。
基础弓术（未入门）：你知道怎么拉弓，怎么瞄准，但能不能射中全看天意。（熟练度34100）
基础剑术（未入门）：虽然你手里握着的是锋利的铁剑，但在旁人眼里，你更像是在拿一根烧火棍驱赶恼人的苍蝇。（熟练度2100）
陷阱制作（lv.1）：你跟老约翰学过如何制作简单的捕兽夹和套索，虽然经常夹到自己的手。（熟练度20100）
野外生存（lv.1）：你能分辨这片森林里大部分的毒蘑菇，并且知道怎么寻找水源。（熟练度45100）
剥皮拆解（lv.2）：这是你这几年干得最多的活，闭着眼睛你都能把一张兔子皮完整剥下来。（熟练度150200）
简易维护（lv.1）：研磨滑石、擦拭油脂、更换损坏的羽箭……你虽然还不会打造神兵，但你懂得如何让一件老旧的武器尽可能晚一点崩坏。（熟练度68100）
【词条库（1）】

【乱语壁垒（绿色·稀有·变异）】
来源：变异野猪的被污染灵魂
“真是非常全面的金手指啊。”
维克多看着面板上的信息，不禁发出一声感叹。
原身这五年的杂役生涯，虽然没有学到老约翰压箱底的本事，但这些基础的生活技能，在荒野求生中往往比杀人技更重要。
尤其是那个【剥皮拆解】，竟然有lv.2，这不仅意味着他能处理猎物换钱，更意味着他对生物结构的了解远超常人。
虽然手里有一个看起来更厉害的词条。
但是当他环顾四周时，大门也碎了，屋子也塌了。
现在的他，就像是一块剥了壳的鸡蛋暴露在荒野之上。
当务之急，还是获得一定的自卫能力，虽然这里比森林里相对安全一些，但也实在好不到哪里去。
“面板上的技能有没有可能也可以被附魔呢？”
简单搜寻一阵后，发现已经没什么像样的武器能够进行附魔了。
于是维克多把主意打到了自己的金手指面板上。
虽然都是些很基础的技能，但是从面板上看，其实也算是琳琅满目的。
他的下一步，应该是穿过荒原，回到黑石镇上。
而这词条看上去也更偏防御侧。
他权衡了一番，用意念拨动那团翠绿的微光，将其按向技能栏中的野外生存。
两者触碰的瞬间，光团如蜡般消融，深深烙印进了原有的技能名称之中。
并没有等待多久，一个新的技能重新出现在了视野中。
【噪点伪装（lv.2）：“乱语壁垒”的反向应用，它能隔绝乱语，也能让你散发出乱语。你在野兽眼里不再是一个人，而是一团没有意义的背景噪音。（熟练度75100）

效果：当你静止不动或缓慢移动时，低智商的野兽和怪物会下意识地忽略你的存在（降低仇恨值），并且你经过的痕迹会变得难以追踪，仿佛被某种混乱的信息覆盖了。】
“哦？不光变成了一个全新的技能，竟然还升级了吗？”
“感觉这个比附魔在武器上划算的多啦，嗯……也或许是因为这是绿色词条的缘故。还需要更多的尝试才能下结论。”
content_en:
;;
Thinking of the entry, Victor's heart moved.
The situation was so critical last night that he didn't even have time to carefully check his gold finger panel.
With a slight movement of thought, the familiar translucent interface appeared on the retina again.
[Name: Victor]
[Status: Slightly weak (recovering)]
[Basic attributes]
Strength: 5.3
Agility: 4.5
Physique: 5.5
Spirit: 7.7 (After resisting mental pollution once, your will becomes stronger)
Because the situation the last time he checked the panel was so critical, Victor didn't even notice that there were skills he had learned below the basic values.
[Skill Column] Although this body has not been systematically trained, five years of experience has allowed you to master some basics.
Basic bow skills (not yet started): You know how to draw a bow and how to aim, but whether you can hit or not depends on God's will. (Proficiency 34100)
Basic swordsmanship (not yet started): Although you are holding a sharp iron sword in your hand, in the eyes of others, you are more like holding a fire stick to drive away annoying flies. (Proficiency 2100)
Trap Making (lv.1): You learned from Old John how to make simple bear traps and lassoes, although you often pinched your hands. (Proficiency 20100)
Wilderness Survival (lv.1): You can identify most of the poisonous mushrooms in this forest and know how to find water. (Proficiency 45100)
Skinning and dismantling (lv.2): This is the job you have done the most in the past few years. You can completely peel off a piece of rabbit skin with your eyes closed. (Proficiency 150200)
Simple maintenance (lv.1): Grind talc, wipe grease, replace damaged arrows... Although you don't know how to build a magic weapon, you know how to make an old weapon break down as late as possible. (Proficiency 68100)
【Term database (1)】
[Girls Barrier (Green·Rare·Mutation)]
Source: The tainted soul of a mutant boar
"It's a very comprehensive golden finger."
Victor looked at the information on the panel and couldn't help but let out a sigh.
In the past five years of my life as a handyman, I have not learned Old John's ability to keep things under control, but these basic life skills are often more important than killing skills in wilderness survival.
Especially the one [Skinning and Dismantling] actually has lv.2, which not only means that he can process prey for money, but also means that his understanding of biological structures is far beyond ordinary people.
Although there is an entry in hand that looks more powerful.
But when he looked around, the door was shattered and the house collapsed.
Now he was like a peeled egg exposed in the wilderness.
The top priority is to obtain a certain degree of self-defense ability. Although it is relatively safer here than in the forest, it is not much better.
"Is it possible that the skills on the panel can also be enchanted?"
After a brief search, I found that there were no decent weapons that could be enchanted.
So Victor put his idea into his golden finger panel.
Although they are all very basic skills, looking at the panel, they are actually quite dazzling.
His next step should be to cross the wasteland and return to Blackstone Town.
And this entry seems to be more on the defensive side.
He weighed it, used his mind to stir up the green shimmer, and pressed it toward the field survival in the skill bar.
The moment the two touched, the light mass melted like wax, deeply imprinting the original skill name.
Not long after, a new skill reappeared in sight.
[Noise camouflage (lv.2): The reverse application of "gibberish barrier", it can isolate gibberish and also allow you to emit gibberish. You are no longer a person in the eyes of the beast, but just a meaningless background noise. (Proficiency 75100)
Effect: When you are stillWhen standing still or moving slowly, beasts and monsters with low IQ will subconsciously ignore your presence (lower hatred value), and the traces you pass will become difficult to trace, as if covered by some kind of confusing information. 】
"Oh? Not only has it become a brand new skill, but it has also been upgraded?"
"I feel like this is much more cost-effective than enchanting weapons. Well... maybe it's because it's a green entry. More trials are needed before we can draw a conclusion."
